name: Ruadan's golden explosion
source: fx-ruadan-explosion.png: 6 frames (the spark, flames and stones, the burst, smoke and fire, smoke and cracks, embers) in a 3 x 2 sheet, its painted amber glow made transparent by a flood that follows the glow's smooth gradient in from the edges and stops at the art's hard edges (frames 1-5 at a step of 6, the embers' frame at 10, where the faintest smoke went with the glow); split with split-sheet.mjs --grid 3x2, each sampled on a 5 px grid (its own pixels) on its own 28 colours; frames moved back into register: frame 1 by 0, 2, frame 4 by -3, 4, frame 5 by -3, 6, frame 6 by -2, 6; all frames cut to columns 1..103 and rows 8..100 of their 108 x 108 grids
